# title: read the txt file with different lengths
# date: 2013.1.24
# raw data: DifferentLengths.txt
# A,B
# A,B,C,D
# A,E,G,H,T,S,D,F,G,W,W,W
# A
# B,C,D
count.fields("DifferentLengths.txt", sep = ",")
max.col <- max(count.fields("DifferentLengths.txt", sep = ","))
data <- read.table("DifferentLengths.txt", sep=",", fill=TRUE, col.names=1:max.col)
data
# end


結果仍可改善:
1. 填滿 NA.
2. 將 T 改為 TRUE, F 改為 FALSE.
